description: This file contains two converter classes for a Windows UI application, ValidSelectedItemConverter and ValidSelectedIndexConverter, which implement data conversion logic for UI bindings within the CalculatorApp project.

classes.name: ValidSelectedItemConverter
classes.description: A converter that passes through the input value unchanged, used for binding validation.

classes.name: ValidSelectedIndexConverter
classes.description: A converter that validates if the input is a non-negative integer wrapped in a PropertyValue, used for index validation in UI binding.

methods.name: Convert
methods.description: Returns the input value unchanged, used in data binding.

methods.name: ConvertBack
methods.description: Validates the input; for ValidSelectedItemConverter, returns the value if not null; for ValidSelectedIndexConverter, checks if the value is a non-negative integer PropertyValue.
